title: Normalized integral and common-stage realization reindexing
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite-field datum D, and for every separated finite-type geometric space T over its algebraically closed field a SpaceData d(T), consisting of the fixed native realization, its exact section-module presentation, tensor/unit data, finite normalizations, and Hom laws [def-sf-adic-realization-isomorphism-data]. There exists a FamilyCore C with exactly C.data = d: its coefficient-ring inverse images are fixed on functions, its integral balanced reindexing is fixed on sections and derived representatives, and its common-stage comparison is natural and satisfies integralRealizationAgreement for every finite integral representative. The module identity and composition maps act as identity on sections; the source identity obeys the unit equation for the specified common-stage pullback composition. Its ambient tensor reindexing is normalized on homogeneous pure tensors and coefficient units, and its source unit is the canonical pullback unit assertion. This conclusion asserts no identity/composition equation for the realization comparison and no tensor/unit/Hom compatibility of that comparison.

source.place: BS Remark 6.8.15; arbitrary scheme-isomorphism reindexing, including semilinear Frobenius; old step 12; HRS: literature/hemo-richarz-scholbach-constructible-sheaves_arXiv-2305.18131.pdf; precise map normalization is the agent-written argument retained in report.md.

proof.text: Apply the proved function-normalized coefficient-ring reindexing theorem at every pair of spaces and underlying isomorphism. That theorem constructs the identity on actual functions using the native section-ring multiplication equation. The coefficient functions formula fixes the resulting ring isomorphism uniquely.

For any normalized coefficient isomorphism, its inverse also fixes functions: apply the functions equation to an inverse image and cancel the inverse/hom composite. Extensionality now identifies the identity and composite coefficient maps. Apply the Mathlib module pushforward identity, composition and site-isomorphism comparisons to these equalities. Prove their section formulas once for arbitrary ring sheaves, where they are reflexivity. The site identity and compositor are eqToHom of equal site objects, since they have identity underlying scheme arrows. The presheaf map_id equation therefore gives the required HEq of sections.

Apply balanced integral reindexing and realization descent separately to every pair of geometric spaces and underlying scheme isomorphism, using the constructed coefficient map. This supplies the integral maps, natural realization comparison and every integralRealizationAgreement equation, without changing the given objectwise SpaceData.

Apply the tensor-model reindexing lemma to the two supplied At structures and the constructed coefficient map. Extract the canonical common-stage pullback unit assertion from derivedPullbackTensorIso. At each geometric space take the source identity normalized against the specified twice-identity compositor.

Assemble these fields into FamilyCore with data literally d. The data equality is reflexivity; the four displayed normalization conclusions are exactly the two proved ordinary section formulas, the integral agreement supplied in step 3, and the source-unit equation supplied in step 4.

proof_origin.place: C4, 2026-10-28: complete Lean assembly, explicit native coefficient and ordinary module coherence constructions, and three strictly smaller normalized subarguments. See coord/reports/C4/Sheaf.Paper.AdicReindexingCore.md.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_normalized_reindexing_core
    (d : ∀ T : GeometricSpace D, SpaceData l D T) :
    ∃ C : FamilyCore l D, C.data = d ∧
    (∀ (T : GeometricSpace D) (M : modules l T.base.left (C.data T).realization)
      (U : T.base.left.ProEtᵒᵖ)
      (x : ((modulePull l T.base.left (𝟙 _) (C.ring T T (Iso.refl _))).obj M).val.obj U),
    HEq (((C.moduleId T).hom.app M).val.app U x) x)
    ∧ (∀ (T U V : GeometricSpace D)
      (g : T.base.left ≅ U.base.left) (h : U.base.left ≅ V.base.left)
      (M : modules l V.base.left (C.data V).realization) (W : T.base.left.ProEtᵒᵖ)
      (x : ((modulePull l T.base.left (g ≪≫ h).hom
        (C.ring T V (g ≪≫ h))).obj M).val.obj W),
    HEq (((C.moduleComp T U V g h).hom.app M).val.app W x) x)
    ∧ (∀ (T U : GeometricSpace D) (g : T.base.left ≅ U.base.left)
      (E : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l (PadicAlgCl l)),
    letI := (C.data T).units
    letI := (C.data U).units
    integralRealizationAgreement l g.hom (C.data T).realization (C.data U).realization
      (C.ring T U g) E (C.integral T U g E) (C.comparison T U g))
    ∧ (∀ (T : GeometricSpace D)
      (M : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l (PadicAlgCl l) T.base.left),
    letI := (C.data T).units
    HEq
      ((pullbackTensorCommonComposition l (PadicAlgCl l)
          (𝟙 T.base.left) (𝟙 T.base.left) M).hom ≫
        (C.sourceId T).hom.app
          ((commonStageDerivedPullback l (PadicAlgCl l) (𝟙 T.base.left)).obj M))
      (𝟙 ((commonStageDerivedPullback l (PadicAlgCl l) (𝟙 T.base.left)).obj M)))
